visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Chidorigafuchi is shown with several blue and yellow rowboats carrying people across a dark green moat. Massive white cherry blossom trees lean over the water from a stone-walled bank where a dense crowd of onlookers is gathered under the blooming canopy. (2) Shibuya Sakuragaoka at night reveals a street tunnel formed by pink-illuminated cherry trees. Pedestrians in dark clothing cross the road while cars with bright headlights pass through the neon-lit urban environment under the dark sky. (3) Meguro River features pink lanterns hanging among white blossoms over a narrow canal. Small boats navigate the water while pedestrians walk along the paved embankments under a slightly overcast daytime sky. (4) Kudanshita displays a street scene where a canopy of white cherry blossoms stretches over a road. White and silver cars drive past while greenery and urban buildings are visible through the floral gaps. (5) Ontake Shrine is marked by a large stone pillar with vertical calligraphy. White cherry blossoms fill the courtyard, surrounded by traditional wooden structures and green trees in a peaceful, overcast setting. (6) Sakurazaka shows a narrow paved road winding uphill, lined with blooming white trees. A black SUV and white cars move slowly as a pedestrian with a clear umbrella walks on the sidewalk. (7) Asakusa Senso-ji temple presents a vibrant red facade and a massive red paper lantern. Weeping cherry blossom branches with pink flowers hang in the foreground while tourists gather near the entrance. (8) Roppongi Midtown features modern architecture and red-paved roads with white blossoms. Pedestrians walk on a pedestrian bridge while a black van with an 'S.RIDE' logo stops at a crosswalk. (9) Close-up shots of a hand holding several delicate pink cherry blossom petals against a green grass background. Later, colorful floral arrangements and decorative pink paper charms are displayed at Musashino Reiwa Shrine. (10) Nihonbashi Muromachi and Kuramae Jinja show urban streets with deep pink cherry blossoms. Yellow mimosa flowers are interspersed with the pink blooms in a bright, sunny park setting. (11) Hourin-ji temple is highlighted with a shot of a pink and blue paper charm shaped like a cherry blossom held against the temple background.
